name: Grafana
description: Dashboards and metrics visualization, installed from the official APT repository.
install_script:
set -e
. /etc/os-release
if [ "$ID" = "ubuntu" ] || [ "$ID" = "debian" ]; then
  mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
  curl -fsSL https://apt.grafana.com/gpg.key | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/grafana.gpg
  echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/grafana.gpg] https://apt.grafana.com stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/grafana.list
  apt-get update -qq
  apt-get install -y grafana
  systemctl enable --now grafana-server
else
  echo "This manifest supports Debian/Ubuntu only; use docker instead." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Grafana: http://<server>:3000 (default admin/admin — change it!)"
uninstall_script:
systemctl disable --now grafana-server 2>/dev/null || true
apt-get remove -y grafana 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Grafana removed"
